name: Resume Ingestion & Claim Extraction
_comment_depends_on: Nothing here is required to START. Every upstream is optional at runtime,
and its absence removes a FEATURE, never the endpoint and never silently.
`on_missing` is shown to a student: write a sentence they can act on.
A missing `base_url` is not a safe default - it silently disables the
upstream even when it IS running, so every entry carries one.
Override any base_url without editing this file: M04_BASE_URL=http://...

depends_on.name: Skill Graph & MNEMOS Memory
depends_on.reason: the concept ontology to scan a resume against, and label -> concept_id resolution for every skill we find
depends_on.on_missing: Skill mapping — needs M04 Skill Graph. We still read the skills off your resume; they just aren't tied to the ontology yet, so nothing downstream can test them.

_comment_feeds: These consume M01. They are NOT dependencies - M01 never calls them - but
the claim and skill shapes are what they read.
Additive changes are safe; renaming or removing a field breaks them.

feeds.takes: resume claims, to weight a JD requirement by what the student has actually done
claim-grounded probes, the resume-specific question source
claims to defend in the interview
the claim under test, to score the defence against
claim provenance for the evidence ledger
